## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: broad sector-level participation (Materials, Energy, Consumer Disc, Industrials strong) alongside major-cap tech divergences (AAPL, NVDA, AMD BELOW TREND) — Leadership: Moderate (Top 5 span 3 sectors).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Materials lead: FCX (1W: +8.86% | 1M: +26.18%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +8.49% | 1M: +13.93%) ABOVE TREND. Energy strong: SLB (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +18.02%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +12.08% | 1M: +5.68%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Discretionary showing strength: AMZN (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +8.54%) ABOVE TREND, HD (1W: +8.33% | 1M: +8.51%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Utilities lag: Utilities sector negative (1W: -0.77%) with likely concentrated weakness. Technology mixed despite positive sector return: AAPL (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -6.43%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -2.11% | 1M: -0.06%) BELOW TREND. Real Estate shows pockets of weakness: AMT (1W: -3.60% | 1M: -5.24%) BELOW TREND, CCI (1W: -5.67% | 1M: -6.14%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTC (1W: +15.67% | 1M: +12.47%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +18.02%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +12.08% | 1M: +5.68%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +12.74%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +8.54%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Moderate (Top 5 span 3 sectors); Style: Value/Cyclical favored.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: AIG (1W: -10.49% | 1M: -0.78%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -9.08% | 1M: -8.33%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -6.43%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -3.83% | 1M: -17.07%) BELOW TREND, CSCO (1W: -2.84% | 1M: -6.58%) BELOW TREND — Weakness concentrated in select tech and financial names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Highest 1W moves: INTC (1W: +15.67% | 1M: +12.47%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +18.02%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +12.74%) ABOVE TREND; watch the divergence with big-cap laggards (AAPL, NVDA BELOW TREND) — tactical momentum, not uniform market replay.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed internals with divergence. GOOGL (1W: +4.26% | 1M: +3.62%) ABOVE TREND and AMAT (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +12.74%) ABOVE TREND contrast with AAPL (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -6.43%) BELOW TREND and AMD (1W: -9.08% | 1M: -8.33%) BELOW TREND; Tech: 13/19 positive.

8. Financials Outlook?
Patchy but tilted positive; large caps generally holding up. JPM (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +10.04%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +0.95% | 1M: +7.13%) ABOVE TREND while CME (1W: -2.68% | 1M: -2.39%) BELOW TREND; Financials: 12/20 positive.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive elements mixed with idiosyncratic moves. UNH (1W: +2.25% | 1M: +6.30%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +1.19% | 1M: +0.59%) ABOVE TREND versus ABBV (1W: -4.03% | 1M: -1.30%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: -1.56% | 1M: +8.28%) CORRECTION; Healthcare: 10/15 positive.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to Materials and Energy leaders (FCX, SLB, PSX) and select Financials (JPM, V) while reducing exposure to large-cap tech laggards (AAPL, AMD, NVDA) until leadership broadens; style: Value/Cyclical favored. Monitor MSFT (1W: +1.34% | 1M: -2.59%) RECOVERY for confirmation before increasing Growth exposure.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +15.67% | 1M: +12.47%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +18.02%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +8.54%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: AAPL (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -6.43%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -2.11% | 1M: -0.06%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -9.08% | 1M: -8.33%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Materials (7 stocks strong) and Energy (8 stocks strong) — breadth confirming. BEARISH: Technology (watch mega-cap divergences) and Utilities (only sector negative this week).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: -2.11% | 1M: -0.06%) BELOW TREND — watch reclaim of near-term resistance for trend repair. AAPL (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -6.43%) BELOW TREND — hold/break of recent swing low will signal deeper risk. JPM (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +10.04%) ABOVE TREND — breakout continuation would reinforce cyclicals. AMZN (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +8.54%) ABOVE TREND — sustained follow-through confirms consumer cyclical leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
BA (+60): Boeing (1W: +2.97% | 1M: +17.05%) ABOVE TREND — news (large defense contracts) confirms price strength. PSX (+60): Phillips 66 (1W: +8.88% | 1M: +1.63%) ABOVE TREND — refining deal and price move confirm accumulation. LLY (+50): Eli Lilly (1W: -1.56% | 1M: +8.28%) CORRECTION — positive clinical news but short-term weakness is a divergence to monitor.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
XOM (-50): Exxon Mobil (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +5.38%) ABOVE TREND — negative headlines diverge from rising price (watch for follow-through). TSLA (-45): Tesla (1W: +1.58% | 1M: -0.04%) RECOVERY — bearish narrative on competition contrasts with short-term bounce; monitor momentum.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, Value/Cyclical favored given Materials, Energy and select Financial strength amid mixed Tech internals. INTC (1W: +15.67% | 1M: +12.47%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +18.02%) ABOVE TREND and AMZN (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +8.54%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: concentrated large-cap tech weakness (AAPL, NVDA, AMD BELOW TREND) and bullish headlines on individual stocks that diverge from price (LLY, XOM) — monitor for confirmation.
